items.text: Let it be — I checked and everything I shipped an hour ago is working in his hands: he climbed the rock, talked to the woman, traded the spoon, sat down, said "thank you!" out loud, and is right now examining the troll with a verb that didn't exist this morning. He's at 18/20 and mid-stride. Nothing I could say would be anything but interruption; the "give bone" trade leak is a note for a build turn, not a reason to speak.
